latest_release.name: rLLM: v0.3.0-pre
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* [feature] add support for on policy distillation by @kylemontgomery1 in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/356
* [Bugfix] Make sure the tracking logger is now explicitly finished by trainers by @listar2000 in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/358
* Add Geo3K Tinker training example with VLM support by @BrianChen26 in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/357
* Support custom metric for SDK by @thwu1 in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/362
* fix: typo in bibtex by @tongyx361 in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/363
* Fireworks API returns raw token ids to avoid re-tokenization by @1stprinciple in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/301
* overlong_filter in stepwise RL by @LianShuQuan in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/365
* Verifiers and Prime Intellect Environment Integration & Example by @alt-glitch in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/367
* Add test_train.sh for docs build by @alt-glitch in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/374
* Resolve Tinker error in advantage computation by @listar2000 in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/375
* Merge nightly branch into main by @listar2000 in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/377
* [Fix] Add a few patches to unified trainer by @listar2000 in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/383
* [Doc improvements] Add the missing multi-GPU configuration options to the evaluation scripts in the quick-start documentation. by @SyncLionPaw in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/384
* [Fix] Further enhancements to the Unified Trainer by @listar2000 in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/385
* [Experimental] Fixing Tinker rollout prompt ids by @listar2000 in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/390
* Reset workflow with task and uid before workflow execution by @JasonWei05 in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/389
* Fully Async Trainer by @thwu1 in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/394
* Add LLM-in-Sandbox to awesome projects by @cdxeve in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/395
* 【Fix】All content in examples/search were empty by @Fulin-Gao in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/396
* [Feat] Important updates to the experimental unified trainer by @listar2000 in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/398
* FinQA Release by @mananroongta in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/393
* Refactor unified trainer async flow and add precomputed-advantage + Tinker rollout fixes by @listar2000 in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/401
* feat(tracking): integrate changes need for the rllm-ui by @Chanbinski in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/402
* Fixed the qwen parser to handle case when model is non-thinking but user put disable_thinking=false as config by @jeewoo-lee in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/405
* Enable TrajectorygGoup's role specific RL advantage estimator via unified trainer hook by @listar2000 in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/408
* Move Tinker backend to rllm.trainer.tinker and deprecate legacy trainer APIs under rllm.trainer.deprecated by @listar2000 in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/409
* Refactor RL advantage estimators and add REINFORCE++ baseline/RLOO support by @listar2000 in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/410
* Extend On-Policy Distillation support with unified trainer example by @BrianChen26 in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/406
* [Doc] Unified trainer docs by @listar2000 in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/414
* [Fix] Put doc images into assets by @listar2000 in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/415
* [Fix] Hot-fix advantage calcuilation unpacking issue by @listar2000 in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/416
* Add deprecation notices in docs by @listar2000 in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/417
* feat(tracking): UILogger with non-blocking background worker by @Chanbinski in https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm/pull/419
* feat(rllm-model-gateway): add standalone proxy server for rLLM  by @luyuzhe111 in https://github.com/rllm
